record_title: Every compact operator on a real Hilbert space is a compact commutator
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to separable infinite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces; the universal constant is not optimized, and no claim is made for smaller prescribed operator ideals, arbitrary real Banach spaces, or nonseparable Hilbert spaces. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk in older real-field compact-commutator literature.
